**Interface** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public interface IPrintJob
```

A job that has been submitted to a printer.

Safe to use from several threads at once, for example to read its status on one while cancelling it on another.

## Properties

### Id

```csharp
string Id { get; }
```

Gets the identifier of the job, as assigned by the print system. Unique only within its printer.

### PrinterId

```csharp
string PrinterId { get; }
```

Gets the identifier of the printer the job was submitted to.

## Methods

### CancelAsync

```csharp
Task<bool> CancelAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Asks the print system to cancel the job.

**Parameters**

- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the request.

**Returns**

`true` if the print system accepted the cancellation; the job then reports [PrintJobState.Canceled](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printjobstate/#values) once it has stopped. `false` if the job had already finished, which can happen between reading its status and asking to cancel it.

**Exceptions**

- [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception): The print system can't cancel jobs.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system refused or failed to cancel the job.

### GetFeature

```csharp
T? GetFeature<T>()
```

Gets what a job of one print system offers beyond [IPrintJob](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintjob/), or `null` if it offers none of that kind.

Use this rather than a cast: jobs from printers the [IPrinterCatalog](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintercatalog/) gives are Latiprimere's own, around the print system's. The default implementation casts this job.

**Type parameters**

- `T`: The interface asked for.

**Returns**

The job as `T`, or `null`.

### GetStatusAsync

```csharp
Task<PrintJobStatus> GetStatusAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Reads the job's current status from the print system.

**Parameters**

- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the operation.

**Returns**

The job's current status.

**Exceptions**

- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system failed to report the job's status.

### WatchStatusAsync

```csharp
IAsyncEnumerable<PrintJobStatus> WatchStatusAsync(TimeSpan pollInterval, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Follows the job until it reaches a final state, reporting each change of its status as it happens.

The Windows spooler signals each change to its queue, so a job there is read when one comes, rather than every `pollInterval`, and at least every 30 seconds in case a change goes unsignalled. CUPS and network printers are read every `pollInterval`.

Arguments are checked when enumeration starts. A job whose state the print system doesn't report is [PrintJobState.Unknown](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printjobstate/#values), which isn't final, so following it goes on until `cancellationToken` is cancelled: pass one with a timeout when that matters. The default implementation reads [IPrintJob.GetStatusAsync](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintjob/#getstatusasync) every `pollInterval`.

**Parameters**

- `pollInterval`: How long to wait between reads of the status when the print system can't say when it changes, so it is polled (see the remarks).
- `cancellationToken`: A token to stop following the job. This doesn't cancel the job itself.

**Returns**

Each distinct status the job reports, ending with its final status (completed, canceled or aborted). A status is reported again only when its state, message, reasons or page count change, never twice the same.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): `pollInterval` is zero or negative, which would ask the print system for the status again and again without pause.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system failed to report the job's status.
